-- First Bank Lollipop Pop Up (2025) - Brand activation with fabricated installation
UPDATE projects 
SET seoKeywords = 'brand activation, FirstBank, experiential design, Lumenati, fabricated installation, pop-up'
WHERE title = 'First Bank Lollipop Pop Up';

-- Add display tags
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (name, slug) VALUES 
  ('Pop-Up Installation', 'pop-up-installation'),
  ('Fabrication', 'fabrication'),
  ('Commercial Campaign', 'commercial-campaign');

INSERT INTO projectTags (projectId, tagId)
SELECT p.id, t.id
FROM projects p, tags t
WHERE p.title = 'First Bank Lollipop Pop Up'
  AND t.slug IN ('pop-up-installation', 'brand-experience', 'fabrication', 'lumenati', 'commercial-campaign', '2025')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM projectTags pt 
    WHERE pt.projectId = p.id AND pt.tagId = t.id
  );
